prompt: You have $\$20$ saved and earn $\$8$ each week. Solve $8w + 20 = 68$ to find how many weeks until you can buy the $\$68$ sneakers.
hint: Undo the $+20$ first: subtract $20$ from both sides.

hints.text: Undo the $+20$ first: subtract $20$ from both sides.

alternativeExplanations.title: As a balance scale
steps: Both sides weigh the same. Take 20 off each pan: $8w$ balances $48$.
Split each pan into 8 equal groups: one $w$ balances $6$.
